opening_condition: Mae and Dax leave the maintenance rib with the stolen anchor-heart after freeing the tagged glass skate; Mae's right sleeve is torn over a rib compression wrap, Dax's coral cape is scorched at the hem, his breath-knot is spent, and both have seen an engine chain embedded in a juvenile keelback.
objective: Cross Hook Market during an induced gravitational lean and carry the anchor-heart to a route where its evidence can be secured.
state_after: The Council's Crown coupling on the juvenile keelback has been witnessed by both Mae and Dax.
The maintenance-rib shudder has begun propagating into Hook Market.
Mae retains the torn right sleeve and rib compression wrap; Dax retains the scorched cape hem.
Dax still has no stored breath-knot after expending it in the maintenance rib.
Dax's scorched cape now has a stretched collar from braking the cart.
The public stair is blocked by a loaded market cart.
Mae and Dax commit to the concealed scale-arcade route.
The anchor-heart casing is dented at one triangular corner.
The cradle's upper lashing is severed and cannot bear full load.
Mae has seen Dax's former crew mark inside the concealed arcade.
Mae knows Dax selected and used her for access to the evidence.
Dax has admitted the Council forecast falsification connected to his dead crew.
The anchor-heart cradle has a temporary lower-capacity splice.
Dax's coral half-cape is torn away and lost in the collapsed bridge gears.
The scale-arcade route is sealed by the fallen loading bridge.
Mae and the dented anchor-heart have reached the inland side.
Mae and Dax's working trust is ruptured.
Mae has explicitly refused Orra's offer of command on Orra's terms.
Mae leaves with sole custody of the dented anchor-heart; Dax remains capeless in the market court.
closing_turn: After Dax admits he used Mae to reach evidence his dead crew found years ago, Mae rejects both him and Orra's offer of command and walks away carrying the dented anchor-heart alone.
